newsitem.title: GERMANY: INSTANT VIEW-German Feb Ifo business index.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-German Feb Ifo business index.

text.p: Following are reactions from economists to publication by the Ifo institute of its survey of German business conditions and expectations in the month of February, which showed an increase in the west German business climate index to 93.6 from 93.3 in January.
ANN KATRIN JAENKE, COMMERZBANK, FRANKFURT: In general this can be taken as a good sign that there will be a pick-up in the economy in a moderate way.
LUTZ WIEGAND, BAYERISCHE VEREINSBANK: "We were at first expecting a little lower. This is a good sign."
"We are now expecting a little increase in the dollar (against the mark) to 1.800 in the coming few months with it then later falling back to 1.700."
